propositions: verify.overlap_enabled does not communicate that it produces duplicate ticket suggestions or that it is advisory, and sits under verify alongside genuinely blocking gates, actively mislabeling it as a gate.

docs/config.md has zero documentation of verify.overlap_enabled or any LLM-backed duplicate detection feature, leaving operators unable to understand the configuration option or its cost implications.
verify.overlap_enabled must be renamed to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets with permanent TOML and env-var aliases to maintain backward compatibility for live configs.

The four config change sites (field declaration, _SECTIONS coercer, _ALIASES entry, two readers in enrich_drain.py and plan_review/__init__.py) plus docs/config.md and docs/adr/0037 must all be updated to use the new name.

docs/config.md must document suggest_duplicate_tickets with details on the three query stages, its advisory nature, cost scaling with tracker size, and cross-reference to the llm.overlap_* algorithm tunables.
